purpose: Fixed exploratory screen: LCRC-FULL vs LCRC-C1 (no b_mean) vs GIN+global on four TUDataset classification datasets, single seed, single 8:1:1 stratified split.

NCI1.node_type: raw discrete node label (Train vocabulary + UNK)

PROTEINS.node_type: raw discrete node label (Train vocabulary + UNK)

edge_cleaning: drop self-loops; merge duplicated directed records into one physical undirected edge per pair; keep isolated nodes and disconnected graphs

split.procedure: train_test_split(train_size=n_train, stratify=y, random_state=0) then train_test_split(rest, train_size=n_valid, stratify=y_rest, random_state=0)
split.test_labels: used only once per run, after the checkpoint hash is recorded

tu_features.node_features: node type one-hot (K) + degree bucket one-hot (17) + in_cycle + minimum cycle size one-hot acyclic,3,4,5,6,7,>=8 + log1p(cycle_degree) + cycle_degree/max(degree,1) + degree==1 + cycle_degree>=3; width K+29
tu_features.s1_s2: directed non-backtracking 2-path enumeration root->middle->end with end != root; no sampling, no truncation
tu_features.normalisation: Train-only mean/scale for the 9 scalars and the 28 global fields; zero-variance scale set to 1

models.FULL: LCRC-A body: atom 128->96, bond 160->96, stat_rank 32, local_hidden 192, h=64, rho_hidden 64; logits = sum_v f(h_v) + rho(global, mean h, mean h^2, log1p n); dropout 0.10 once per forward
models.C1: identical to FULL with only the 96-d b_mean = b_sum/degree block deleted; shared initialisation mapped from the seed-0 FULL state
models.GIN: node linear -> 64, 5 GIN layers (train_eps, eps=0, MLP 64-128-64, LayerNorm-SiLU-dropout 0.10 residual), concat[sum_pool, mean_pool, global28, log1p n] -> 157-64-C

recipe.selection: max Valid accuracy, tie -> lower Valid CE, tie -> earlier epoch
recipe.test_policy: one evaluation per run after the checkpoint hash is saved

baseline: Train-majority constant classifier (zero training cost, not one of the 12 runs)
